caption: Fig.2.9    Equipment for studying the photoelectric effect. Light of a particular frequency strikes a clean metal surface inside a vacuum chamber. Electrons are ejected from the metal and are counted by a detector that measures their kinetic energy.
note: Labels listed top-left to bottom-right as printed. 'Fig.2.9' is printed with no space after 'Fig.' (unlike 'Fig. 2.8' elsewhere on these pages) and is kept exactly that way. Two deviations from a literal box reading, both declared: (1) target_box_in_crop's bottom edge (y=630 in a 1059x830 crop) cuts the caption's last line, so the closing word 'energy.' sits just below the box; it is the same caption sentence of this very block, not a neighbouring block's text, so the caption is given complete rather than truncated mid-phrase at 'their kinetic'. (2) The display line 'E = 0, h-nu, 2h-nu , 3h-nu....nh-nu.....' falls inside the top of the box but belongs to the preceding equation block, so it is excluded from caption and labels. The '+' and '-' polarity marks on the tube electrodes and on the battery are printed on the drawing but are circuit polarity signs rather than named labels, so they are not listed. Excluded as outside the box: the prose 'from the following set, but cannot take on any values between them.' above, the entire right-hand column (items (iii) and the 'All the above results...' paragraph), the '2024-25' footer, and the diagonal 'not to be published' watermark. The flat list cannot record that the labels point to parts of one apparatus (light beam, detector, metal surface, electron stream, meter, chamber, battery) wired as a circuit.
